text.style: fill: #222222; font: 7.8px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: What it does: Before each weight update, if the gradient's total size is above a threshold, it is scaled down to that threshold;

text.style: fill: #222222; font: 7.8px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: the direction is kept. AutoClip moves the threshold every step to the 10th percentile of the gradient sizes seen so far.

text.style: fill: #222222; font: italic 7.8px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'
